name: groundwork-common/post-portal
description: Front-end editing for the people who own your content, without a wp-admin login.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit suite. Needs no database and no WordPress checkout.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHPCS against phpcs.xml.dist, which is what a directory reviewer runs.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fix what PHPCS can fix on its own.
scripts-descriptions.compat: Check the source really does run on the PHP version the header claims.
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything, in the order a failure is cheapest to read.
